result:
I passed the August and September archive: 4,248 screenshots (483 MB) moved to E:, every copy was checked against its original, and the undo was tested twice on a separate copy of the repo. The Sessions page and the scripts that read the sessions still work.

⚠️ The work differs from the brief in two ways, and you should know about both:
- **Only the pictures left.** Every task log, page and doc stayed in the repo, because removing them from git would have freed no space in `.git` and broken old links. The agent recorded this choice and the alternative in its task log.
- **The pictures were deleted from C: outright**, not removed through git, so git cannot bring them back. The E: copy (plus the full backup from 15:53) is the only copy left, which makes a second copy on Cloudflare R2 more important.

The owner note, card report and landing line aren't written yet. The review is in [review.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/archive-phase-2/review.md).
